## Où j'en suis
Staging analytics RDS now runs PostgreSQL 17.2 after a blue/green switchover at 14:20 UTC on Nov 17 (41 s of refused writes); pg_partman was upgraded to 5.1.0 first, maintenance was green on events_raw and events_daily, and dbt passed 14/14 models on 17.2 (+3% runtime, within noise). PR #57 is open as draft with commits 7e3c9d4 (logical replication in the module) and b0f18a2 (staging engine 17.2); the runbook now lists rds.logical_replication=1 + reboot as prod step 0. No prod date: Maya wants a full incident-free week on staging first. (source: ses-pg-3, src-pr57, src-slack-infra)

- [en-cours] Full-week staging soak on 17.2 before Maya's sign-off; earliest sign-off Nov 24 (source: ses-pg-3, src-linear-kes298)
- [en-cours] PR kestrel-analytics/infra#57 open (draft); prod still prepared but disabled behind pg17_enabled=false (source: src-pr57, ses-pg-1)
- [prochaine-étape] Watch staging through the week; report anything off in #infra (source: src-slack-infra, ses-pg-3)
- [prochaine-étape] After sign-off, book two prod windows outside the 01:00–03:30 UTC dbt lock: reboot for rds.logical_replication=1 (≈2–3 min downtime), then blue/green switchover (source: ses-pg-3, ses-pg-1)
- [prochaine-étape] Enable prod (pg17_enabled=true) and execute runbooks/pg17-upgrade.md (source: ses-pg-1, ses-pg-3)
- [essai-raté] First staging apply failed: blue/green requires logical replication — fixed with rds.logical_replication=1 (pending-reboot) in the pg16 parameter group plus a reboot (1m48s) (source: ses-pg-3)
- [essai-raté] terraform init -upgrade selected AWS provider v6 (37 unrelated changes); pinned to ~> 5.82 instead (source: ses-pg-1)
- [question] Prod cutover date and exact windows: unset, pending Maya's sign-off (source: ses-pg-3, src-linear-kes298)
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off; apply_immediately stays false (source: s1-04, s3-09)
- [décision] AWS provider pinned to ~> 5.82.0, no v6 in this PR (source: s1-02)
- [décision] Prod runbook step 0: set rds.logical_replication=1 and reboot (own window, ≈2–3 min prod downtime) before creating the blue/green deployment (source: s3-09)
